Laura (ML): hey — rolled v2p1-int4 to a 5% cohort (cohort-B) for doc-summarize around 08:00 PT. quick smoke looks ok on latency but eval concordance dropped for that cohort (~3.5% absolute vs baseline).

Sam (SRE): which concordance metric specifically? top-1 exact match or the rerank concordance?

Laura (ML): rerank_concordance primarily + a small uptick in hallucination_count on long prompts (>2k tokens). latency p50 improved ~10ms.

Alina (Research): can you paste the mini-breakdown? samples or metric slice?

Laura (ML): pasting probe output:
```
cohort: B
requests: 12.3k
rerank_concordance: baseline=0.842 -> v2p1-int4=0.807 (delta -0.035)
hallucination_count_per_k: baseline=1.4 -> v2p1-int4=2.0
latency_p50: baseline=210ms -> v2p1-int4=200ms

slice: long_prompt (>2k tokens)
concordance delta: -0.07
```

Sam (SRE): oof. That long_prompt slice doing the damage. Any config diff? beam/temperature same?

Laura (ML): same decoding. suspect KV-cache alignment + quantized attention kernels with long-kv warmup. not observed in shadow runs (maybe data skew).

deploy-bot: Auto-fallback monitor observed cohort-B concordance delta > 3% for 8 minutes; flagging.

Jay (Product): do we want to auto-roll back cohort-B only, or pause promotion entirely? Product impact is medium but visible on legal-doc flows.

Alina (Research): propose cohort-scoped rollback rule: if per-cohort delta(concordance, 5m rolling) > 0.03 AND slice_hit_rate(long_prompt) > 10% then rollback cohort only. pseudo-rule:
```
if rolling_delta(cohort, metric='rerank_concordance', window=5m) > 0.03 and slice_share('long_prompt') > 0.1:
    rollback(cohort)
else if global_delta(metric='rerank_concordance') > 0.05:
    global_rollback()
```

Sam (SRE): sounds reasonable. we can implement cohort-level circuit-breaker today as a temporary ops rule. i'll flip cohort-B to fallback variant and monitor.

Laura (ML): thanks. I'll run a focused replay for long_prompt samples against cpu-quant kernels and unquantized variant to collect diffs.

Jay (Product): please add an item to the rollout-runbook: "per-cohort slice-aware fallback" + owner. also notify CS for customers hitting legal-doc flows.

Sam (SRE): done — cohort-B rolled back to v2p1-fallback at 08:12 PT. monitoring. :thumbsup:

Laura (ML): sweet. will follow up with a short postmortem + candidate mitigations (kv warmup tweaks, slight attention kernel tiebreaker, or keep int8 for long prompts).

Alina (Research): also suggest a small canary that specifically targets long_prompt slice (5% of traffic) before next promote.

Jay (Product): agreed. queueing that for today's promote checklist.

deploy-bot: Incident note created: 1768543210-cohort-concordance-delta.

Laura (ML): thanks team — ping me if you see regression re-appear.
